linen-wrap-dress.name: Linen Wrap Dress
linen-wrap-dress.description: A fluid wrap silhouette in washed linen. Soft drape, adjustable tie waist, and a midi length that moves with you.

wool-tailored-blazer.name: Wool Tailored Blazer
wool-tailored-blazer.description: Structured shoulders, a nipped waist, and a lightly padded lapel. Cut from Italian wool for everyday polish.

wide-leg-denim.name: Wide-Leg Denim
wide-leg-denim.description: High-rise wide-leg jeans in a vintage wash. Rigid cotton that softens with wear and holds a clean crease.

cashmere-crew.name: Cashmere Crew Knit
cashmere-crew.description: A weightless crewneck in Scottish cashmere. Ribbed cuffs and a relaxed body for layering through the season.

camel-overcoat.name: Camel Overcoat
camel-overcoat.description: A classic single-breasted overcoat in camel hair. Notch lapel, welt pockets, and a full lining for cool evenings.

oxford-shirt.name: Oxford Shirt
oxford-shirt.description: Button-down oxford cloth with a boxy, slightly cropped cut. Washed for a lived-in hand from the first wear.

pleated-trousers.name: Pleated Trousers
pleated-trousers.description: Single-pleat trousers in a drapey wool blend. Tapered from the knee with a clean break at the shoe.

heavyweight-hoodie.name: Heavyweight Hoodie
heavyweight-hoodie.description: Brushed fleece hoodie with a generous hood and dropped shoulders. Cut for warmth without bulk.
